messages:
Elaine (Docs): Heads-up: PR #482 opened to update SDK snippets & upgrade examples. Linkcheck/vale failing on CI. https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/482
ci-bot: linkcheck: 2 broken links found
```
LinkCheckError: https://old.docs.redwood.com/sdk/auth -> 404
LinkCheckError: https://example-external.com/guide -> 502 (timeout)
```
mike (SDK): I changed param name in examples from `model` to `model_id` — did snippet tests account for that?
sam (Eng): Looks like snippet tests expect the old API. Either update tests or revert snippet. short turnaround needed. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
julie (Peer reviewer): Can someone run docs preview locally? My quick run shows MD013 (line-too-long) + vale 'WeaselWords' on "very easy" in getting-started.md
Elaine (Docs): Running `npm run docs:preview` now, will paste logs in a sec
Elaine (Docs): paste of local CI run:
```
markdownlint: /docs/getting-started.md:23: MD013/line-length Line length [Expected: 120; Actual: 172]
vale: /docs/tutorials/create-app.md:45: WeaselWords/very-very Use stronger wording than "very easy"
snippet-tests: FAIL examples/sdk/quickstart.md -> tests/snippet-runner: expected `client.generate(...)` but found `client.create(...)`
```
mike (SDK): ah — I must have renamed the example helper. I'll update the example to call `client.generate` and push a fix. Also spotted a broken relative link in docs/sdk/auth.md (was pointing to https://old.docs.redwood.com/sdk/auth)
sam (Eng): Prefer minimal change: make snippet-tests accept both `create` and `generate` to be backward-compatible for one release, then update callers.
julie (Peer reviewer): Agree with compatibility route. For Vale/style issues, I'll reword "very easy" -> "straightforward" in that paragraph.
ci-bot: re-run requested by @mike — job queued (circleci #8242)
mike (SDK): pushed commit 5b7a3a2 to PR — updated snippet harness to allow both method names, fixed broken link in docs/sdk/auth.md, and replaced "very easy" wording. Ran `vale --config=.vale.ini` locally (no errors) and `npm run linkcheck` (locally shows external 502 still flaky).
Elaine (Docs): Thanks. CI shows linkcheck still failing on external site due to cached redirect to old.docs. I'll add an allowlist entry for that host in linkcheck config (so our CI doesn't fail on known external flake).
sam (Eng): Is adding an allowlist ok with security/compliance?
Elaine (Docs): Yes — we've got approval for that host from security (checked with infra). It's a documentation redirect we don't control. I'll include a comment in config.
ci-bot: All checks passed — linkcheck, markdownlint, snippet-tests, vale. ✅
julie (Peer reviewer): :rocket: LGTM from me. Elaine please wait 15m before merge in case of flake.
Elaine (Docs): Merging now. Will monitor docs preview staging for 10m.
sam (Eng): thanks everyone :tada:
